subject: Initial eval playbook + collaboration doc for Helix Ops
messages:
From: Emma Liu <emma@helix-analytics.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@helix-analytics.com>, Helix Procurement <procurement@helix-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial eval playbook + collaboration doc for Helix Ops

Hi Grace —

Thanks for the demo last week. The team liked the latency and the quantization options; procurement wants a short, shared plan that outlines milestones and the timeline before we move to an SOW. Can you share a MAP template we can iterate on?

High-level asks from our side:
- 6–8 week pilot scope (ingest + 1 production endpoint)
- Security checklist (SOC 2 evidence + network requirements)
- Cost estimate banding for peak vs. steady traffic

I can convene the stakeholders on Tue/Thu afternoons. If you can drop a first-draft doc with suggested dates and owners, we’ll mark it up.

Best,
Emma
Emma Liu
Director, Ops — Helix Analytics
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Liu <emma@helix-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial eval playbook + collaboration doc for Helix Ops

Emma —

Appreciate the clear asks. I attached a first-pass MAP (Helix-MAP-v1.gdoc) and our lightweight MAP template (redwood-map-template.xlsx). The doc includes a recommended 7-week pilot schedule that maps to the items you listed. Quick highlights:

- Week 1: Kickoff + data access + security review (owners: Helix: Raj; Redwood: Marissa)
- Weeks 2–4: Integration + test runs (deliverable: end-to-end demo + cost telemetry)
- Week 5: Load/latency validation and QoS tuning (deliverable: perf report)
- Week 6: Stakeholder review + decision gate (success criteria list)
- Week 7: Optional ramp plan / SOW handoff (if decision = go)

Action items for your side:
1) Confirm stakeholder list and preferred demo date(s) (we suggested Jun 23 or Jun 25).
2) Fill in procurement fields on the last tab of the template for billing & PO cadence.
3) Share any additional compliance artifacts we should pre-stage for SOC review.

I also included a short cost banding example in the template — using two configurations (dedicated small pool vs. burst on hosted) so you can see unit economics. Marissa and Dylan are copied for technical and PM coordination.

I left a few inline comments in the Google Doc. If Wed afternoon works we can run a 30-min walk-through.

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Engage Lead, West Coast — Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0134
Attachments: Helix-MAP-v1.gdoc (link), redwood-map-template.xlsx (download stub)
From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@helix-analytics.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Liu <emma@helix-analytics.com>, Helix Procurement <procurement@helix-analytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2026 10:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial eval playbook + collaboration doc for Helix Ops

Grace / team —

We reviewed the MAP and left comments in the Google Doc. A few clarification points from engineering:
- We need the exact S3 path pattern and IAM role suggestion for incremental ingestion.
- Can you confirm whether the KV cache stays warm across scale-up events (important for tail latency)?
- For the cost banding, can you provide an estimate assuming 10 qps sustained and a 95th-percentile latency SLO of 150ms?

Procurement flagged the billing cadence question — we prefer monthly invoicing for pilot. I attached a placeholder SOW (Helix_SOW_v0.3.pdf) for your review; it's not final.

We can do Wed, Jun 23 at 1:00pm PT for the walk-through. That works for stakeholders.

Thanks,
Raj
Senior Platform Engineer — Helix Analytics
Attachments: Helix_SOW_v0.3.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@helix-analytics.com>, Emma Liu <emma@helix-analytics.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Helix Procurement <procurement@helix-analytics.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2026 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial eval playbook + collaboration doc for Helix Ops

Raj / Emma —

Thanks for the comments — helpful. Quick answers inline and next steps:

- S3 + IAM: recommended pattern and sample IAM policy added to the MAP doc (see "integration notes" section).
- KV cache behavior: keeps warm for warm pools; we included a recommended warm-up flow and a fallback latency profile if scaling from zero.
- Cost estimate for 10 qps / 95th 150ms: added a conservative and optimized row in the cost banding tab (see redwood-map-template.xlsx).

On billing cadence: monthly invoices for the pilot is fine; we'll reflect that in the SOW and add a short payment schedule appendix.

Next steps before Wed 6/23 1:00pm PT:
- Helix: confirm final attendee list and any additional compliance docs to surface during the kickoff (Emma)
- Redwood: update MAP with IAM snippet + updated cost rows (Marissa)
- Redwood: share calendar invite and a short agenda (Grace)

I'll update the doc and re-share the link by EOD today. Looking forward to the walkthrough.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (650) 555-0199
Attachments referenced: redwood-map-template.xlsx (cost + IAM examples)
